title: 执行者交回一步的东西

kind.description: patch: the full set of nodes and edges for this step. covered: the step's existing nodes on the canvas still hold; omit nodes and edges.

name.description: Node name shown on the canvas and used as an edge endpoint. Unique across the canvas. When rebuilding a step, reuse the existing names so downstream edges stay attached.

type.description: One of the node types in the node table, e.g. llm

params.description: Slot values keyed by the slot keys in the node's row of the table. A slot left for the user is omitted here and named in blanks.

blanks.description: Slot keys left for the user to fill: folders, tables, connections, schemas. Empty when nothing is left open.

note.description: One sentence to the user, in the language the user wrote in: the one judgement the card does not show (why this node, why this value, or why a slot is blank). The card already shows the slot values; a note that repeats them tells the user nothing.

to.description: Target node name; at least one end is a node of this step

output.description: Only when the source node has several outputs (condition: "true" or "false"). Omit otherwise.
